subject: Discovery recap: SOC 2 Type II access, bridge letter & DDQ kickoff
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@skyrun.io>, Elena Rodriguez <elena@skyrun.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: SOC 2 Type II access, bridge letter & DDQ kickoff

Hi Sanjay / Elena —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation and good alignment on latency/cost goals for your AI inference use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a clear path for procurement and security signoff: 

- Immediate asks from your security team: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) or an interim bridge letter 
- Access to your trust portal or secure upload link so we can get artifacts into our vendor management tracker 
- Start the DDQ / vendor security questionnaire (we can send our DDQ link or ingest yours) 

Proposed next steps: 
1) Can you share the SOC 2 Type II report or an official bridge letter (PDF) by EOD Tuesday, 25 May? If you plan to send a bridge letter instead of the full report, please include the coverage period.
2) Please provision trust portal access for security@redwood.ai (or we can provide a secure upload link).
3) Which DDQ format do you prefer? We can push our template (short, focused on hosting, data retention, and encryption) or complete your vendor questionnaire.
4) I'll add Ben (CS) and Lauren (Legal ops) to any subsequent threads for procurement/contract steps.

Attached: redwood-compliance-request-form.pdf — short form our security team uses to track artifacts and access.

If helpful I can block 30 minutes next week for a security intake working session. Thoughts?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

--
Attachment: redwood-compliance-request-form.pdf (stub)

From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@skyrun.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rodriguez <elena@skyrun.io>, Skyrun Security <security@skyrun.io>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: SOC 2 Type II access, bridge letter & DDQ kickoff

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick update from the Skyrun security team: 

- Attached is a bridge letter that covers our latest audit window and confirms we are actively finalizing the Type II report. The bridge letter includes scope (inference API hosting, data processing controls) and the audit period. (See attached: Skyrun-Bridge-Letter.pdf)
- We'll provision a one-time upload to your trust portal invite (security@redwood.ai) within the next 24 hours. Expect an invite from trust@skyrun-vault.com.
- For the DDQ: we prefer you send your short DDQ first — that will let us answer the high-priority items sooner and we can follow with our vendor portal responses if you need deeper artifacts.

Timeline: bridge letter sent (attached). Portal invite will be sent today. For the full Type II report, target availability is mid-June (estimated completion is 2027-06-14).

Let me know if you need the bridge letter notarized or an attestation contact.

Best,
Sanjay Mehta
Head of IT & Security | Skyrun Inc.
sanjay@skyrun.io | +1 (617) 555-0129

--
Attachment: Skyrun-Bridge-Letter.pdf (stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@skyrun.io>, Elena Rodriguez <elena@skyrun.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: SOC 2 Type II access, bridge letter & DDQ kickoff

Thanks Sanjay — that timeline works. Appreciated. A few follow-ups from our side: 

- We'll accept the bridge letter for initial security review. Please include the named auditor and scope page if possible (helps our compliance checklist).
- I'll accept the portal invite and confirm once I see it. If the portal supports folder-level uploads, please put the bridge letter and any mapping doc into a folder named "Redwood - SKY-4719".
- DDQ: sending our short questionnaire now (one-off email from security-portal@redwood.ai) — if you can complete the highlighted items (data retention, encryption at rest/transit, subprocessor list) first, that will speed procurement sign-off.

Ben / Lauren — once the bridge letter and the portal upload are in, can we target a 48-hour turnaround for an internal red-team readout and a short procurement checklist? Ben, can you confirm SLA for vendor readouts?

If helpful I can share a link to our trust portal onboarding instructions — attaching a short guide now.

Thanks again — I'll flag items in the DDQ that are blockers vs informational.

Hannah

--
Attachment: trust-portal-onboarding.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@skyrun.io>, Elena Rodriguez <elena@skyrun.io>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: SOC 2 Type II access, bridge letter & DDQ kickoff

Thanks team — quick note from procurement side: 

- Once bridge letter is verified and DDQ has the critical controls filled, procurement can issue a standard SOW + order form. We're aiming for a 7–10 business day turnaround from receipt of complete security artifacts to an initial contract draft.
- If Skyrun needs an accelerated procurement path (to hit an internal launch window) let us know and we can prioritize. That may require a short vendor exception and a senior security attestation call.

Hannah — I'll stand by for the portal invite and the completed DDQ items. If bridge letter arrives notarized that helps but isn't required for initial review.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0177
